newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan state airliner traffic up 15.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan state airliner traffic up 15.7 percent.

text.p: Jordan's state carrier saw a 15.7 percent rise in passenger traffic in the first three months of 1997 compared to the same period last year, its planning department said on Monday.
Royal Jordanian carried 319,571 passengers from January to end of March 1997 and passenger seat factor rose to 65.3 percent compared to 63 percent in the same period last year.
Total cargo during the same three month period rose 23.6 percent to 20,206 tonnes against the same months of last year.
Freight load factor rose 60 percent in the first three months of 1997 against 54.7 percent in the same period last year.
Traffic was markedly higher on the Indian, Middle East, Far East and North African routes, the airline said.
